thought.title: ReduceSum 替代标量累加循环 + block_M 调优
thought.description: 将逐元素标量累加循环 for(i=0;i<N;i++) sumSq+=v*v 替换为 AscendC::ReduceSum<float>(dst, src, tmp, N) 硬件矢量归约。O(N) 标量循环变为 O(log N) 硬件归约，同时 block_M 从 128 调整为 64 提升小 M 并行度。
thought.reason: 对标 add_layer_norm 历史优化经验，标量循环在 Vector 处理器上 O(N) 开销极大，ReduceSum 利用硬件矢量归约单元。pattern reduce-sum-replace-scalar-loop 直接适用。
thought.target_bottleneck: 标量累加循环O(N)在Vector处理器上串行执行

runtime.dsl_before: float sumSq = 0.0f; for (int32_t i = 0; i < t_.N; ++i) { float v = addFp32(i); sumSq += v * v; } float invRms = 1.0f / sqrt(sumSq * t_.invN + t_.eps); AscendC::Muls(addFp32, addFp32, invRms, t_.N);
runtime.dsl_after: AscendC::ReduceSum<float>(reduceOut, xFp32, reduceTmp, t_.N); float sumSq = reduceOut.GetValue(0); float invRms = 1.0f / sqrt(sumSq * t_.invN + t_.eps); AscendC::Muls(compFp32, compFp32, invRms, t_.N);
